meta.description: A calm check-in before you spend. Ask Sadiq, your AI money co-pilot, before you buy.

hero.lead: A calm check-in before you spend.
hero.body: Ask Sadiq, your AI money co-pilot, before you buy. Built for everyday life in Qatar.
hero.userMessage: Should I get the new sneakers? QAR 320
hero.sadiqAfter: left for fun this month. Still want it?

challenges.title: Spending well is harder than it should be.
challenges.body1: It's not that we're careless. The moment we decide to buy is set up against a clear-headed choice.
challenges.body2: ShouldAI is built to take on each of these, right when you're about to pay.

items.title: Impulse hits late at night
items.text: Most impulse buys happen half-scrolling, one tap from checkout, not at the mall.

items.title: You never see the full picture
items.text: What's left this month, weekend plans, what you're saving for: none of it is on the checkout screen.

items.title: Budgeting apps look backward
items.text: They tell you what you spent after it's too late to undo.

steps.title: Tell Sadiq what you're about to buy.
steps.text: Type it like you'd text a friend: what it is and what it costs.

steps.title: Sadiq checks it against your budget and goals.
steps.text: What's left this month, what you're saving for, and what's coming up next.

steps.title: You decide with a clear head.
steps.text: No lectures, no blocked cards. Just the full picture, and then it's your call.

sadiq.title: A level-headed friend who remembers your budget.
sadiq.body: Sadiq is the AI inside ShouldAI. No judging, no guilt trips, no blocking your card. Just a quick, honest look at the numbers so you can pause, think, and choose on purpose. Sometimes the answer is “go for it.”

messages.text: Thinking of getting new headphones. QAR 650.
That's more than your fun budget for the month. If you set aside QAR 100 a week, you'd have it in about six weeks without touching your savings goal.
Fair call. I'll keep it on your wishlist. Check back Friday?

app.title: Your whole month, on one calm screen.

features.title: A budget that keeps score
features.text: See what you've spent this month, what's left, and how many days are still to go.

features.title: Savings you won't spend by accident
features.text: Set a goal and Sadiq keeps that money protected from impulse buys.

features.title: Sadiq Savings
features.text: Every purchase you decide to skip adds up, so you can see what a pause is worth.

features.title: Know your patterns
features.text: Spending by category, plus a heads-up when late-night shopping starts creeping in.

app.mockupLabel: The ShouldAI home screen: QAR 1,496 spent of a QAR 5,000 monthly budget, a QAR 1,000 savings goal on track, QAR 810 saved by skipping purchases, and spending split across shopping, entertainment, food and transportation.
app.savedSub: purchases you told Sadiq you'd skip
